_comment: High/Critical advisories that the pinned scanners do NOT reliably report for Alpine (Trivy reads Alpine's secdb, which lists fixed CVEs only; Grype matches some of them only through NVD CPE ranges). Each entry ADDS a finding whenever one of its packages is installed: at a listed affected version it is an unfixed High that needs an owner decision; at any other version it must be re-verified against the Alpine security tracker and this file updated. This list never removes or downgrades a scanner finding. Process: packages/rab-docker/docs/IMAGE_SECURITY_RELEASE_POLICY.md section 6.
evidence: docs/DOCKER_SCOUT_VS_TRIVY_2026-11-02.md section 3.1 and the 2026-11-03 CVE recheck (Alpine tracker states, secdb, APKINDEX v3.24 and edge, NVD)
